anthropics-official/frontend-design.whenToUse: Use when creating polished web interfaces, pages, components, dashboards, or application UI.

anthropics-official/mcp-builder.whenToUse: Use when designing or implementing an MCP server that exposes external services as model tools.

anthropics-official/skill-creator.whenToUse: Use when creating a new Skill or improving an existing Skill package and its instructions.

anthropics-official/slack-gif-creator.whenToUse: Use when creating an animated GIF optimized for posting in Slack.

anthropics-official/theme-factory.whenToUse: Use when applying a coherent color and typography theme to documents, slides, pages, or other artifacts.

anthropics-official/webapp-testing.whenToUse: Use when testing a local web application, reproducing UI behavior, capturing screenshots, or inspecting browser logs.
